title: What’s New in MiiTuber 0.3.0
items: Added **Mouse tracking**. In the Tracking menu, set Track with to Mouse and your Mii looks at your cursor, even while a game is fullscreen. Keep MiiTuber open, not minimized.
Added **blink settings** to the Tracking menu. Choose Camera, Camera + auto, or Auto only, and set how often and how long your Mii blinks. Auto only helps if glasses or glare cause false blinks.
Added **Shading style** to the Avatar menu. Choose Wii U, Switch, Miitomo, 3DS, or Wii lighting for your Mii.
Added Mirror tracking to the Tracking menu. Your Mii turns, tilts, and winks the opposite way, which helps if you flip the capture in OBS.
Added Head Rotation Offset to Advanced tuning. Use the Pitch, Roll, and Yaw sliders to tilt or turn your Mii's head by a fixed amount.
Blinking no longer resets your Mii's expression. Happy, angry, sad, and surprised faces stay on while you blink.
Reorganized the side menu into Avatar, Tracking, Microphone, Scene, and Advanced. Show body is now in Avatar, and the background settings are in Scene.
footnote: Mii Creator custom features do not work with MiiTuber.
